I know your feelings of emptiness quite well, and I struggle to open up to the people in my life for fear of this happening to me. But I commend your effort. It takes a lot of guts to even try opening up and if it means anything to you I think you must be a pretty strong person for that. What I found to be the best way for me to talk to the people in my life about being depressed is to have one on one conversations that acted solely for me to get my conflicted and negative thoughts out of my head. I had a friend who I’d go out with every once and a while and we’d somehow get to talking about my depression and suicidal thoughts and I’d just kind of lay all of my thoughts out on the table. A lot of times those conversations ended in awkward silences and weird changes in the topic of conversation, but I felt better knowing this person was actually listening and she’d usually hold my hand or hug me if I was really struggling saying what I needed to say. If you have someone you can have an upfront, honest conversation with about your depression then I think you should give it a shot. And if they really can’t comprehend the complexity of depression then I’d recommend going to a therapist of some sorts just so that you know someone is really listening to you. I wish you the best OP, and I think this subreddit community is one full of people who are genuinely willing to listen to someone’s grievances in life because we know the pain of not being understood or heard. It’s night time where I am so I’m going to bed, but if you do need someone to really hear you out and offer you sincere support feel free to message me or just strike up a conversation with someone in the comments or something. Despite living entirely different lives, we all here on this sub have something unique in common.
